title: On the dimensions of correlated equilibrium polytopes of generic games
summary: In this paper, we study the dimension of the correlated equilibrium polytope of finite games. Under the oriented-matroid notion of genericity, we prove that if a generic game is not full-dimensional, then there exists a subgame whose correlated equilibrium polytope is affinely isomorphic to that of the original game. This settles and generalizes an earlier conjecture of Brandenburg, Hollering, and Portakal (2024).
